semantics.clock: All state transitions occur on rising clk edges.
semantics.reset: Active-high asynchronous areset; rising areset sets walking-left immediately; held high overrides clock transitions. Deassertion does not change state.
semantics.initialization: No specified power-up state before reset.
semantics.walking_left: If ground=0 enter falling-left regardless of bumps; otherwise bump_left=1 changes to walking-right, regardless of bump_right; otherwise remain walking-left.
semantics.walking_right: If ground=0 enter falling-right regardless of bumps; otherwise bump_right=1 changes to walking-left, regardless of bump_left; otherwise remain walking-right.
semantics.falling: Ignore both bumps. ground=0 continues falling; ground=1 resumes remembered walking direction at that edge, ignoring landing-edge bumps.
semantics.outputs: Moore outputs: walking-left=(1,0,0), walking-right=(0,1,0), either falling state=(0,0,1), in order walk_left,walk_right,aaah. Input changes between edges do not change outputs except asynchronous reset.
semantics.sampling: ground and bumps sampled on rising clock; outputs reflect updated state after sequential update.

numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, overflow, rounding, saturation, or numeric datapath.
numeric.state_encoding: Four states may be represented by two unsigned bits; encoding not externally observable.

verification.oracle: Independent behavioral model using separate remembered-direction and falling Boolean variables, derived from original problem.
verification.coverage: Test every combination of ground and bumps from all four states; simultaneous bumps; wrong-side bumps; falling persistence; fall-entry and landing bump suppression; asynchronous reset in every state; held reset; input mutation between edges.
verification.comparison: Compare all three outputs after each rising edge and asynchronous reset, and between edges for Moore stability.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp; finite shell timeout and testbench watchdog. Preserve compilation and simulation logs.

specification_ambiguities: Behavior before reset and for unknown input values is unspecified; development tests use binary inputs and assert reset before functional checks.
